author: Stephen King
summary: A high school teacher in Maine finds a portal in a diner that leads back to 1958. He decides to live through the intervening years and try to stop the assassination of President Kennedy, building a new life along the way.
readIf: you like time-travel stories with a strong sense of period and a slow, affecting love story.
skipIf: you expect classic horror or a short thriller, as this is long and focuses on character.

pairings.reason: A time-bending romance with the same ache for a life lived out of order, in a quieter key.
If you want the tension of changing your own past but at a quicker, more thriller-like speed.
Another big, character-rich King book set on a vast American canvas, with more horror and a bleaker tone.
